def test_solution():
    # Basic cases
    assert solution([1, 2, 3]) == 3          # indices 0,2 -> 1 + 3... wait, idx 2 is even, 3 is odd -> 1+3=4
    # Correcting: idx 0 -> 1 (odd), idx 2 -> 3 (odd): sum = 4
    assert solution([1, 2, 3]) == 4

    assert solution([1, 5, 2, 3, 4]) == 6    # idx0:1, idx2:2(even), idx4:4(even) -> 1 only? No:
    # idx0: 1 (odd, even idx) -> include
    # idx2: 2 (even number) -> exclude
    # idx4: 4 (even number) -> exclude
    assert solution([1, 5, 2, 3, 4]) == 1

    assert solution([5]) == 5                # single odd element at even index
    assert solution([4]) == 0                # single even element at even index

    # Empty list
    assert solution([]) == 0

    # Odd elements at odd indices should not count
    assert solution([0, 1, 0, 1, 0]) == 0    # odd numbers only at odd indices
    assert solution([2, 3, 2, 3, 6]) == 0    # odd numbers only at odd indices

    # Mixed case
    assert solution([3, 3, 3, 3, 3]) == 9    # idx0:3, idx2:3, idx4:3 -> 9
    assert solution([30, 13, 24, 321, 0]) == 0
    assert solution([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 0

    # Negative odd numbers at even indices
    assert solution([-3, 2, -5]) == -8       # -3 + -5
    assert solution([-1, 4, -1, 4, -1]) == -3

    # Larger list
    assert solution(list(range(10))) == 2 + 6  # idx2 -> 2 (even num), idx4 -> 4, idx6 -> 6, idx8 -> 8 => 0
    # Only odd values at even indices count; range(10) evens at even indices => 0
    assert solution(list(range(10))) == 0

    print("All tests passed!")


# Run tests
if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_solution()

def test_solution():
    # Standard case: odd values at even indices
    assert solution([5, 8, 7, 1]) == 12  # 5 (idx 0) + 7 (idx 2)
    
    # All odd values, multiple even indices
    assert solution([3, 3, 3, 3, 3]) == 9  # 3 (idx 0) + 3 (idx 2) + 3 (idx 4)
    
    # Even values at even indices -> no contribution
    assert solution([30, 13, 24, 321]) == 0
    
    # Odd values only at odd indices -> no contribution
    assert solution([2, 3, 4, 5]) == 0
    
    # Empty list
    assert solution([]) == 0
    
    # Single odd element at index 0
    assert solution([5]) == 5
    
    # Single even element at index 0
    assert solution([4]) == 0
    
    # Negative odd numbers at even indices
    assert solution([-3, 2, -5]) == -8  # -3 (idx 0) + -5 (idx 2)
    
    # Mixed positive/negative
    assert solution([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == 9  # 1 + 3 + 5
    
    # Large numbers
    assert solution([1000001, 2, 1000003]) == 2000004
    
    # Zero at even index (zero is even, not odd)
    assert solution([0, 1, 0, 1]) == 0
